response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune, o.recordvault FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), c AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY ordertune), s AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: 'Executed orders' means distinct orders that have at least one execution row with a matching order, counted per order type. An order with several executions is counted once.
A NULL ordertune is its own group. The overall average share is the unweighted mean of the type shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of types, including the NULL group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count execution rows (fills) per order type instead of distinct orders.
